messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the adjacent Saturday–Sunday.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Good Friday** | April 7 (Friday) | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) | Easter weekend |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) | Celebrates Queen Victoria |
| **Canada Day** (observed) | July 3 (Monday) | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) | Official holiday on July 1 (Saturday), observed on Monday |
| **Labour Day** | September 4 (Monday) | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) | First Monday in September |
| **Thanksgiving** | October 9 (Monday) | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) | Second Monday in October |
| **Remembrance Day** | November 11 (Monday) | **Nov 9–11** (Sat–Mon) | Commemorates fallen soldiers |
| **Christmas Day** | December 25 (Monday) | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) | Official holiday on Dec 25 (Monday) |

> **Bonus:**  
> *New Year’s Day* fell on Sunday, January 1, so the extended weekend was **Dec 31 – Jan 2** (Fri–Sun).  
> *Boxing Day* was on Tuesday, Dec 26, so it didn’t create a long weekend.

Feel free to plug these dates straight into your holiday‑planning app!
